The '''Registered Bank of Ammuud''' was a major financial institution headquartered on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ammuud/Legends|Ammuud]],<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|III|90|Registered Bank of Ammuud}}</ref> a world located within the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a significant fraction of the Registered Bank of Ammuud's collateral was stored on the planet [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
